description: This file declares functions for parsing and printing IPv4 and IPv6 addresses, including handling optional parameters such as port and network mask.

methods.name: li_parse_ipv4
methods.description: Parses an IPv4 address string, optionally extracting netmask and port.

methods.name: li_parse_ipv6
methods.description: Parses an IPv6 address string, optionally extracting network and port.

methods.name: li_ipv6_tostring
methods.description: Converts an IPv6 address into its string representation, appending to the provided GString.
